name: Nature Manitoba Native Habitat Grant
summary: Grants of up to $3,000 for conserving, restoring and managing native habitat in Manitoba, with native prairie as the priority. Open to individuals, community groups, NGOs and agencies working in the province.
reporting: Recipients report at the end of the grant year (31 March) on how the funds were used and what they contributed to the project's aims.

calls.label: Yearly application deadline
calls.recurring: Applications are due on 31 January each year; award by end of March.

status.quote: Applications are due on January 31st of each year, with the grant awarded by the end of March in that year.

recurring.quote: Applications are due on January 31st of each year, with the grant awarded by the end of March in that year.

applicant_types.quote: The Native Habitat Grant will be available to Manitobans or other qualified individuals, landowners, researchers or agencies working in Manitoba. This includes colleges, universities, non-governmental organizations, community groups, municipal, provincial, federal and/or international agencies.

geography.quote: The Nature Manitoba Native Habitat Grant has been established to provide funds for projects and activities in Manitoba

access.quote: Applicants must email a PDF file to Nature Manitoba (nativehabitatgrant@naturemanitoba.ca)

window.quote: Applications are due on January 31st of each year, with the grant awarded by the end of March in that year.

amount.quote: Each year, Nature Manitoba intends to award one or more Native Habitat Grants of up to $3000 each

reporting.quote: Grant recipients will be required to submit a report at the end of the grant year (March 31) detailing how the Native Habitat Grant funds were used and how these funds contributed to the aims of the project.
